DATA_START is entered only right after the PART state matched BLANK_LINE_RE. It deletes the buffer only up to the midpoint of that match, `(match.start() + match.end()) // 2`. The second line break (`
`, `` or `
`) therefore always stays at the start of the buffer. `LINE_BREAK_RE.match` always succeeds there, so the buffer is never empty. For `

` the whole `
` remains, so a lone `` is never mistaken for the full break.
